summary: Targeted responsive retest of /docs after fix changing docs header nav from 'hidden md:flex' to 'hidden lg:flex'. All 6 measurements (3 viewports x 2 routes) show NO horizontal overflow. Tablet (768): top-nav links hidden, mobile toggle visible & opens drawer. Desktop (1920): top-nav links + sidebar visible. Mobile (390): toggle visible, drawer opens. docs-home renders on /docs, doc-content renders on /docs/architecture across all widths. The MEDIUM bug from iteration_13 is RESOLVED.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correct and minimal: lg:hidden on mobile-toggle pairs with hidden lg:flex on top-nav and hidden lg:block on sidebar — consistent breakpoint usage across all three regions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Responsive fix in /app/frontend/src/docs/DocsPortal.jsx verified at 768/1920/390 on /docs and /docs/architecture. Measured scrollWidth == clientWidth on all six combinations (768/768, 1920/1920, 390/390). Mobile drawer toggle opens docs-mobile-drawer on both tablet and mobile. Topnav links visible only at >=1024 (desktop). Sidebar visible only at >=1024.
